pr_title: Fix pasting to recycle bin - Issue 899
pr_comments: @gave92 Can you please solve the merge conflicts?

issue_context.title: App doesn't show or crashes when moving an object to Recycle Bin
issue_context.body:
Today, I found the feature of Recycle Bin in the app and then went on to use it. With the Files app open on the side of my desktop, I dropped one of my shortcuts to the bin and when i checked into the recycle bin of the app, there was nothing but the file explorer was showing the deleted shortcut. Next, I cut a folder from the desktop through the app and then pasted it in the recycle bin of the app, the app got stuck for a few mins with high disk usage but then crashed unexpectedly 

I understand that it is an experimental feature. Thus, I didn't give a bad rating. I expect the problem to be fixed as soon as possible.

(The Microsoft Store Version app)
 - OS Version: [Windows 10 2004]
 - App version: [v0.9.1.0]
comments:
@Cyberdroid1 I am happy you found the experimental feature we just added, this is still a work in progress and your feedback will help us improve it further.
cc @gave92

[debug.txt](https://github.com/files-community/files-uwp/files/4727474/debug.txt)

The link for the file is given above. Please inform me if there is any sensitive info. The error happened yesterday only (twice). I did not find the debug_fulltrust.txt in the mentioned folder. Can you please tell where is it located?

Hello, today I tried to use the Recycle bin again. I right clicked on a file and clicked on move to Bin. The file disappeared from the path. Then I went on to check the recycle bin of the app but it wasn't there. Then I opened the recycle bin of file explorer but there also the file was missing. But soon the app crashed.

Thanks for the feedback. Could you confirm that:
- you right clicked on a file in the app
- you selected "Delete" from the context menu
- you accepted the delete dialog without checking the "Permanently delete" option
- the file was nor in the original path nor in the bin (both checked through windows explorer)?

If the app crashed please post the `debug.txt` again.

i had recently tried to tweak the Terminal Applications option and had opened the terminal.json file and added the id for fluent terminal. But then the app started to crash at startup. then i set the file back to its original state but still it failed to start. Thus i reinstalled the app. 

Now i tried to right-click a file in the files app, and click on delete. The dialog box to whether permanently uninstall came but i left it unchecked and clicked delete. Then a black dialog box came up but it remained empty and nothing came up. I closed it and tried again. Still the same thing.
 
Anyways, i am posting the debug.txt file after the reinstall.
[debug.txt](https://github.com/files-community/files-uwp/files/4736154/debug.txt)
Also, the file never got deleted. The Recycle bin feature is failing badly. Though the empty recycle bin feature worked perfectly as intended.
I also noted one thing. The recycle bin feature worked for empty folders but a box appears when trying to delete a filled folder, a strange black dialog box appears.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/51435948/83878040-22714d00-a759-11ea-8cd7-69d89a6547cf.png)

Here is the image of the strange black dialog box.
Hope it helps...
Hello, I tried what you said. But the black box still appears. Can you please share what the black box is meant to do? I am a bit curious 😉
This might have something to do with Files UWP not supporting file shortcuts.

Wow, a small bug led to such a big conclusion. Maybe that's why the shortcuts on my desktop don't appear here in the Desktop tab of the app.

So the app doesn't support showing the shortcut of the deleted file? Because the files in the recycle bin of file explorer do appear in the recycle bin of the app.

review_comments: Note: this change is not specific to pasting to the recycle bin but can happen when pasting in any folder
